scope: Actual source-bound mutual-TLS administration service on only the owned ND OuterA management interface. Certificate DER-SHA256 role map and complete API permission table are public.

SecurityAdministrator may readstate/audit, change one diagnostic input-filter rule and rotate retained logs. Auditor may readstate/audit and rotate logs, but cannot change the filter. An issuer-trusted unmapped certificate gets no API permission.

Synthetic credential-to-role mapping does not establish actual appointment, clearance, organizational reporting/review, full product administration, all other debug/configuration interfaces or OS/hypervisor confinement. Host Docker/root and VM host access remain explicit trusted controls.
The API has fixed handlers and constant argv operations; no arbitrary file retrieval, path mapping or command arguments are accepted. Private-key API path is explicitly denied to every role.
